mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increase does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased consumer spending within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of periods following the increase in HOUST, or HOUST increase does not lead to broader economic growth indicators within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not lead to a broader economic slowdown within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a slowing economy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described conditions do not lead to a slowing economy within the next year.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong consumer demand and a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the described conditions do not lead to a robust economic expansion within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month, without a corresponding increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE does not increase
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the described conditions do not lead to increased economic activity within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong economic growth and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% in 6 months and UNRATE is stable or decreases
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the described conditions do not lead to a sustained economic expansion within the next year.
